_notes: A base class may be NAMED WITH ITS PACKAGE: `inherit = pkg::Parent`. R6 documents it and
extractNamedArguments read only `identifier` and `string`, so a `namespace_operator` value
produced NO edge at all. Census: 738 class-constructor calls across 2,342 admitted R files,
exactly 1 qualified base class — a one-edge gap, pinned as one.
All four carriers are asserted because one helper (extractNamedArguments) sits behind all of
them; a fixture that tested only R6 would pass with S4/R5/S7 still broken.
forbidRelationships pins that the PACKAGE is not published as an endpoint: a symbol named
`pkgA::AC` binds to nothing in any file, and the class identity is the bare `AC`.
THE LABEL OF THE R5 ROW MOVED, THE EDGE DID NOT: `RC`'s `contains = c("VIRTUAL", pkgB::BaseRC)`
is a LIST-shaped composition clause, so it publishes `mixes_in` (one per composed class) and the
extends rows for it are now forbidden — the same targets, the split label. The single-base
carriers (BC, SC, CD, class_sd) stay `extends` because R's `is()`/`extends()` answer TRUE for
one named supertype; the fixture pins both halves so a widened or narrowed split goes red.
